items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
At least 1 year of experience supporting clinical research, laboratory research, research administration, or research coordination activities.

Join the Center of Pathology Research Services (CPRS) and play a vital role in advancing biomedical research at UCLA. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with researchers, manage research study operations, and support the successful execution of pathology-based clinical research projects. The Assistant Research Coordinator serves as a central point of contact for research studies utilizing CPRS services and coordinates study-related activities from initiation through completion.
Assist with administrative, regulatory, operational and budgetary support to the CPRS Director and Manager.
Create, track and monitor pathology study applications.
Ensure all necessary documentation, such as IRB approvals and Data User Agreements, are in place for each active study.
Collaborate with UCLA and external researchers to ensure the successful development, execution, and completion of clinical research studies and service requests.
Coordinate client support functions, including pricing for service requests, budget development for grants, and processing new study or service requests.
Coordinate biospecimen handling, including procurement, processing, storage, shipping, and distribution.
Serve as liaison with CPRS core facilities and clinical laboratories to facilitate seamless research coordination.
Serve as point of contact for all research related requests.
Maintain study records, databases, and tracking systems to ensure accurate documentation and timely completion of project milestones.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
